## Mathematics & Physics Educator | Data Analyst

I'm a Learning Manager at [Holland College](https://www.hollandcollege.com) (Summerside, PEI), teaching mathematics and physics to post-secondary students. I hold an MSc in Mathematics, a BEd in Secondary Education, and a joint honours BSc in Applied Math and Physics.

Previously, I worked as a Health Information Specialist at Health PEI analyzing healthcare data, and taught mathematics at the College of the North Atlantic in Carbonear, Newfoundland.
